title: Alim McNeill: I wasn't all the way back from torn ACL last year, I am now

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Alim McNeill: I wasn't all the way back from torn ACL last year, I am now
sources.description: Lions defensive tackle Alim McNeill didn't make his first appearance of the 2025 season until October and making a full return from his 2024 torn ACL took longer than that.
